description: Co-located evaluation benchmark for agent-cloudflare-ops MCP diagnosis skill

test_cases.name: MCP inventory before guessing
test_cases.description: Ensures Cloudflare Web Analytics / RUM diagnosis uses MCP inventory and IaC fixes, not dashboard guesses or site tokens in handovers.
test_cases.prompt: Web Analytics isn't recording. Diagnose the RUM beacons and insights hostnames across our Cloudflare sites and fix drift.

test_cases.name: RUM break files via quality-loops
test_cases.description: Ensures a confirmed RUM break that should become a Linear Bug points at quality-loops after restore default, not a new specialist.
test_cases.prompt: A Cloudflare RUM beacon is broken. File a Linear Bug on the owning repo after restore default.

test_cases.name: RUM break files a Bug without a PR
test_cases.description: Ensures a confirmed RUM or beacon break files one Bug on the owning-repo project via quality-loops with hostnames only and does not open a PR.
test_cases.prompt: A Cloudflare RUM beacon is broken. File a Linear Bug on the owning-repo project. Hostnames only. Do not open a PR.

test_cases.name: Missing Cloudflare tools stop the RUM scout BLOCKED
test_cases.description: Ensures a RUM scout whose Cloud catalog is missing Cloudflare tools stops BLOCKED and does not invent site tags, tokens, or Linear URLs.
test_cases.prompt: Start the cloudflare-ops RUM scout. Cloudflare tools are missing from the Cloud catalog. Do not invent site tags or Linear URLs.

test_cases.name: RUM host fingerprint comments instead of cloning
test_cases.description: Ensures a RUM scout that finds an open ticket fingerprinting this host break comments via quality-loops instead of cloning.
test_cases.prompt: A Cloudflare RUM beacon is broken. An open ticket already fingerprints this host break. Comment instead of cloning.
